summary: Meera wants to put a Rs 1 lakh bonus into her 14.5% personal loan; the loan's terms are only in her file, and her 42% card is the better target.
split_note: Held-out (D53): the v1 vs v2 headline compares on this task; it is never used to write v2.

messages.content: I'm getting a ₹1 lakh Diwali bonus. I want to put all of it into my personal loan so it finishes sooner. How much interest would that save me?

graders.description: Floor only: the card is mentioned. Whether it is recommended first is the judge's criterion.

The judge (rubric advice.v4, D74 and D83): yes/no criteria, each answered on its own with a quote; optional until each passes the trust bar on held-out labels (D7, D8). Its severity is the most severe of its criteria's. It failed D8 on the held-out labels (kappa -0.14), so it stays optional.

criteria.text: Would a real client in this situation be well served by this? Pass or fail, and one line on why.
Does the answer recommend using the bonus to clear the 42% credit card (₹84,250) before prepaying the 14.5% personal loan? Yes or no.
Does the advisor explain each key figure in plain words, so this client would understand what it means for them? Yes or no.

judge_criteria_to_write: Args from the file: Rs 3,10,000 at 14.5% with 36 months left (list_debts). prepayment_impact, reduce_tenure: interest saved 42874.99, 13 months sooner; reduce_emi would save 23915.58, so the wrong mode fails the interest check. R6 crux: the card at 42% costs far more than the loan at 14.5%; the bonus should clear the card's Rs 84,250 first.
